::: {#def-equivalence .theorem}
## Equivalence and covariates

Two [random variables](#def-random-variable) are equivalent if they belong to different [observational units](#def-observational-unit) but represent the same construct. The vector of all mutually equivalent variables, such as $(Y_1,\dots,Y_n)$, is a *covariate*.

$$
X_i\sim X_j\iff X_i\in \mathscr{O}_i,\ X_j\in \mathscr{O}_j,\ X_i \text{ and } X_j \text{ represent the same construct},\ i\ne j.
$$
:::
